//: PLACEHOLDER texts, English second (bot.ru.json is the primary language). The keys in drafts wait for the owner's VALUES step (OPEN-QUESTIONS Q4, PROTOTYPE-PLAN V5), which empties drafts in both files: the /terms, /support and /paysupport texts hold no real contact, name or address yet, and the payment and refund notices are engineering wording. Plain text, no parse mode; bounds in server/src/telegram/texts.rs.

texts.start: Welcome! This is a visual novel right inside Telegram. Tap the button below to start playing.
texts.terms: Terms of use. The game is provided as is. Chapters and hints are bought with Telegram Stars and tied to your Telegram account; a refund of the Stars revokes the purchase. The full terms will be published before launch.
texts.support: Support. If something does not work, write to us; the support contact will be given here before launch. Telegram support cannot help with purchases made through this bot. Payment questions: /paysupport.
texts.paysupport: Payment support. Telegram support cannot help with purchases made through this bot: for payment questions, contact us; the contact will be given here before launch. Please quote the payment number from the list below.
texts.paysupport_unavailable: Your payment list is unavailable right now. Please repeat /paysupport in a minute.
texts.payment_unapplied: Payment {charge} was received, but the purchase could not be applied. Your Stars are being refunded automatically. The payment number helps if you contact us (/paysupport).
texts.admin_unapplied: Unapplied payment {charge} from user {payer}: {outcome}. The automatic refund has started; a separate alert follows if Telegram refuses it.
texts.admin_auto_refund_failed: The automatic refund of payment {charge} to user {payer} stopped after {attempts} attempts. Last error: {error}. Refund it by hand: /refund {charge}
texts.refund_done: Payment {charge} refunded. The purchase is revoked unless another payment paid for it.
texts.refund_failed: Could not refund payment {charge}: {error}. Nothing changed, please try again.
texts.refund_unknown_outcome: The refund of payment {charge} is not confirmed ({error}): Telegram may already have returned the Stars. Repeat /refund {charge}; repeating is safe.
texts.reject_unknown_order: This invoice was not found. Please start the purchase again in the app.
texts.reject_mismatch: This invoice does not match the order. Please start the purchase again in the app.
texts.reject_already_owned: You already own this, no payment is needed.
texts.reject_in_progress: This purchase is already being paid for. Please wait a couple of minutes and check the app.
texts.reject_expired: This invoice has expired. Please start the purchase again in the app.
texts.reject_temporary: The order could not be checked. Please try again in a minute.
